searchText: I'd propose for the next devnet we do 8148 + 8383 and the one after we do do 8334 + 8411 bundling together the networking EIPs waggle implementations are likely thin on the ground, regarding 8334 + 8411? not sure where we are with the networking eips implementation, but I know prysm has a prototype of 8148, which is why I suggested it hm, 8148 is ... conceptually whatever, but https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8148#validator_sweep_thresholds-mapping-in-beaconstate is problematic, not sure why it wasn't flagged yesterday. These per-every-validator lists are the single biggest thing by far in the state but ok there might be a better way to do this, hide it in some other field (it doesn't need anything like 64 bits to specify -- it needs ~11 bits) I think there was some discussion about it yesterday that the threshold could be part of the pubkey somehow so that we wouldn't need to take up some extra space in the beacon state for it the withdrawal credential has lots of empty space in it yeah I'm pretty neutral-to-even-slightly-positive towards this EIP except for that it's _awful_ and I don't care how "simple" it is 0x02<11 bits for the threshold>b9d7934878b5fb9610b3fe8a5e441e8fad7e293f I'd propose to work on hegota-devnet-0 as the next devnet. It will be focusing on FOCIL and Frames interaction and including some PRs that make FOCIL more robust and stable. yeah I agree, we should focus on the merged devnet, this is just a forward looking planning thread for whats after that and to evaluate in what shape these EIPs are in Probably 8148 and 8383. The others may take time to implement https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12598/changes#diff-d95ccfcca7f20809a4bf25f10c9ab466b43239a6826772509634e90116e7216eR637 <@654267572107083777> better? checking I'm always a bit confused whether ppl prefer big or little endian consensus spec became little endian, execution has been big-endian oh wow yeah thats confusing as fuck lol why can't people agree to just one? yeah SSZ little endian, RLP big endian ok well I can make this to little endian if you want but thats a small detail imo adjusting my pr to lil end ok, yeah it's more consistent with consensus spec side for sure I don't have a "personal" preference per se, but yeah I kinda hate little endian I have a consistency preference and consensus spec prefers little endian makes it less obvious to read but also haven't been reading hex in a good while lol corresponding consensus spec change: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5790 yeah looks ok, I mean, maybe could be tweaked further if people want, but approved the EIP one (not sure processwise if/how that matters) basically needed to check whether it'd break a particular Nimbus optimization and no, it's fine would rather get these in the spec and then debate further changes than risk the state bloat I'll get the lido guys to also review the prs and they can merge it in too with these changes, I'm now again neutral-to-positive on this EIP. it's a kind of nice change we could even kill 0x01 now yeah that's probably my favorite part we already had this mechanism in a way, just with kind of arbitrary constraints a lot of the complication was sort of in the spec already The eip suggestion has been merged in, can someone from spec side also take a look at https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5790 pls <@592004585506340885> <@845691100072509460>
